summary: test_argv_resume_appends_interrupt_prompt_on_agent_turn calls the real HARNESS.argv() (no mocks) with turn='agent' and asserts exact list equality with INTERRUPT_PROMPT appended after the session flags on the session-id resume path; the sibling REQ-027.1.1 test uses the same seeded session with default turn and asserts the identical prefix without the prompt, rejecting the always-append counterexample. Genuine behavioral check, not keyword theater.
